questions.question: In the Harry Potter films, what is the name of Harry’s owl?
questions.note: A snowy owl. Errol is the Weasleys’; Crookshanks is Hermione’s cat; Fawkes is Dumbledore’s phoenix.

questions.question: What Quidditch position does Harry Potter play?
questions.note: The Seeker hunts the Golden Snitch.

questions.question: What is the name of Elsa and Anna’s kingdom in Frozen?
questions.note: Corona is Tangled; Atlantica is The Little Mermaid; DunBroch is Brave.

questions.question: Which superhero team’s first standalone Marvel Cinematic Universe film was released in 2012?
questions.note: Directed by Joss Whedon; it assembled Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, and Hulk.

questions.question: In The Lord of the Rings, who is Frodo’s gardener and companion on the road to Mordor?
questions.note: Sean Astin plays Sam. Merry and Pippin take a different path.

questions.question: What is the title of Spielberg’s 1997 sequel to Jurassic Park?
questions.note: Jeff Goldblum’s Ian Malcolm is the lead this time; the island is Isla Sorna.

questions.question: What is the name of Tom Cruise’s spy in the Mission: Impossible films?
questions.note: The first Mission: Impossible film landed in 1996.

questions.question: What is the subtitle of the second Hunger Games film?
questions.note: Mockingjay was then split into two films.

questions.question: In the Marvel films, what is the name of Thor’s hammer?
questions.note: Stormbreaker is the later axe; Gungnir is Odin’s spear.

questions.question: Which Star Wars film, released in 1999, began the prequel trilogy?
questions.note: Episode I — a young Anakin, podracing, and a lot of debate about Jar Jar.
